1. (Currently amended) A cooling system installable within a structure wall, comprising: a pump; a pad; a water distributor; a motor; and a fan, __wherein the cooling system is installable between wall studs and within the structure wall such that a housing of the cooling system protrudes from an inside wall surface less than three inches__.

2. (Currently amended) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the studs are spaced [[about]] __sixteen__ inches on center.

3. (Currently amended) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the studs are spaced [[about]] __twenty-four__ inches on center.

4. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the pump brings water from the water reservoir to the water distributor and the water distributor distributes the water to the pad thereby moistening the pad.

5. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 4, wherein the fan causes air to flow through the pad moistened by the water, thereby cooling the air by evaporation.

6. (Currently amended) The cooling system of claim 5, wherein the fan causes the cooled air to flow through an opening __in the structure wall to an indoor area__.

7. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 4, wherein at least some of the water flows back to the reservoir for recirculation.

8. (Original) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the water reservoir is filled with additional water when the water in the reservoir falls below a predetermined level.

9. (Original) The cooling system of claim 8, further including a ball float valve that opens to fill the water reservoir with the additional water when the water in the reservoir falls below the predetermined level.

10. (Original) The cooling system of claim 1, further including a water drain.

11. (Currently amended) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the housing includes a front cover __flush with an inside wall surface__.

12. (Original) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the housing protrudes from the wall less than three inches.

13. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the wall is a load-bearing wall.

14. (Original) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the structure is a garage.

15. (Currently amended) A cooling system kit, comprising: the cooling system of claim 1; mounting elements; and a ventilation grill __for covering the opening in the structure wall__.

16. (Original) The cooling system kit of claim 15, further including instructions.

17. (Currently amended) A cooling system, comprising: [[in a means for mounting within a structure wall, a means for evaporatively cooling an indoor area]] __an evaporative cooling system mounted within a structure wall and configured for evaporatively cooling an indoor area__.

18. (Currently amended) The cooling system of claim 17, wherein [[the means for mounting includes placing the means for evaporatively cooling between wall studs spaced about sixteen inches on center]] __the evaporative cooling system is placed between wall studs spaced sixteen inches on center__.

19. (Currently amended) The cooling system of claim 17, wherein [[the means for mounting includes placing the means for evaporatively cooling within a structure wall, the structure wall constructed using one of structural insulated panels (SIP) and insulating concrete forms (ICF)]] __the evaporative cooling system is placed within a structure wall, the structure wall constructed using one of structural insulated panels (SIP) and insulating concrete forms (ICF)__.

20. (Currently amended) The cooling system of claim 17, wherein [[the means for enclosing protrudes from the wall less than three inches]] __a housing of the evaporative cooling system protrudes from the wall less than three inches__.
